if(BAJI_V2)
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../firmware-v2/component.cmake")
    return()
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "main.c"
        "badge_runtime.c"
        "badge_onboarding_store.c"
        "badge_pet_store.c"
        "ui/badge_onboarding.c"

        # The care kernel: five cares, the refusal rules, the stat arithmetic and the
        # fixed alert priority list, all read out of 《吧唧交互规范》.
        "pet/badge_pet.c"

        # The specification's vocabulary. badge_spec_data.c and badge_assets_data.c are
        # GENERATED by tools/gen-badge-ui.mjs and tools/gen-badge-assets.mjs -- edit the
        # generators or _ref/baji-spec/吧唧交互规范/badge_spec.json, never these two.
        "ui/badge_spec_data.c"
        "ui/badge_geom.c"
        "ui/badge_paint.c"
        "ui/badge_assets.c"
        "ui/badge_assets_data.c"
        "ui/badge_fsm.c"
        "ui/badge_ui.c"
        "ui/badge_overlay.c"
        "ui/badge_motion.c"
        "ui/badge_frame_clock.c"
        "ui/badge_tutorial_visual.c"
        "ui/badge_ui_plan.c"
        "ui/badge_cat.c"

        # The four specification faces (16/20/24 px rounded + 40 px numerals).
        "ui/fonts/badge_f16.c"
        "ui/fonts/badge_f20.c"
        "ui/fonts/badge_f24.c"
        "ui/fonts/badge_n40.c"
        "ui/fonts/badge_n44.c"

        # The 3D cat: the ported rasteriser's LVGL host. cat3d itself is a component.
        "hw/badge_audio_policy.c"
        "ui/cat_view.c"

        # The uplink and the radio.
        "net/badge_events.c"
        "net/net_link.c"
        "net/net_proto.c"
        "net/net_social.c"
        "net/app_link.c"

        # The board's non-display hardware: IMU, PMIC, touch, codec.
        "hw/badge_hw.c"

        # Kept for the radio layer, which still advertises from a pet_game_t: the
        # shadow record app_link.c keeps in step with badge_game_t. See the note at the
        # top of net/app_link.c.
        "pet/pet_state.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "."
        "pet"
        "ui"
        "net"
        "hw"
)

# The vendored font files include "lvgl/lvgl.h" unless this is defined, and this
# project's LVGL include root is managed_components/lvgl__lvgl itself (so <lvgl.h>
# resolves and <lvgl/lvgl.h> does not). ESP-IDF sets LV_CONF_INCLUDE_SIMPLE, not this
# one, so without the define all four faces fail to compile.
target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE LV_LVGL_H_INCLUDE_SIMPLE)

# The board has no hardware to fall back on, so a warning that survives into a
# flash image is a defect nobody sees until the board misbehaves.
#
# -Werror is what makes that sentence true rather than aspirational: without it the
# warning still ships and the build still reports success. It is scoped to this
# component's own sources, so the vendor components' warnings cannot fail our build.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
